Interface BackendProvider

All Known Implementing Classes:
AeshBackendProvider, JLineBackendProvider, PanamaBackendProvider
public interface BackendProvider
Service provider interface for creating Backend instances.

Implementations of this interface should be registered via the Java ServiceLoader mechanism by creating a file META-INF/services/dev.tamboui.terminal.BackendProvider containing the fully qualified class name of the implementation.

Applications should include exactly one backend provider on the classpath (e.g., tamboui-jline). If multiple providers are present, use the tamboui.backend system property or TAMBOUI_BACKEND environment variable to specify which provider to use (by simple name or fully qualified class name).

  • Method Details

    • name

      default String name()
      Returns a simple identifier for this backend provider.

      This name is used when selecting a provider via the tamboui.backend system property or TAMBOUI_BACKEND environment variable. The default implementation derives a name from the class name by removing "BackendProvider" suffix and converting to lowercase.

      Examples:

      • JLineBackendProvider → "jline"
      • PanamaBackendProvider → "panama"
      Returns:
      a simple identifier for this provider (e.g., "jline", "panama")
